narrative.overview:
The school is built the way Great Zimbabwe is built: coursed granite laid without mortar, a band of slanted blocks crowning the wall, and openings you walk through. Everything in the system is either stone, a joint between stones, or a gateway cut into the wall. Sunlit granite is the ground, shadow granite is the ink and the dark courses, and the only saturated colours are the logo blue and navy, which carry action, and one lichen ochre, which is the only marker.

Structure comes from masonry, not from boxes. Sections are separated by chevron bands and by courses of blocks set 5px apart. Corners are square. Slabs sit on the wall with a hairline top light and a real offset drop shadow, and nothing glows, blurs or fades into a gradient.

The system is built and verified on the public home page and the login screen. The rest of the app inherits its tokens only.
keyCharacteristics: Two granite states: sunlit ground for reading, shadow stone for the hero wall, principal section and footer.
Square corners everywhere; 5px dry joints between blocks; hairline borders in joint-line grey.
One signature ornament: the chevron band, a mask-painted course of slanted blocks that can take any fill.
Logo blue and navy for every action; ochre for markers only.
Archivo 800 for headings at large sizes, Public Sans for text.
One motion: the hero wall laid course by course.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Ochre is the only marker colour. It marks a place (where you are, where a gateway opens, which link is a link); it never fills a surface, never carries body text on light ground, and never appears with a second accent.

rules.name: The Logo Carries Action Rule
rules.body: Every control that does something is logo blue or navy. Stone, ochre and charcoal never stand in for a primary action.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Ochre text appears only on shadow stone or navy. On sunlit ground ochre is a line, not letters.

rules.name: The Cut Letter Rule
rules.body: Archivo is set at 700 or 800 only. A light or regular heading looks like paper, not stone.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: There is no small uppercase line above a heading, no numbered section tags, no tracked-out caps label. A heading stands alone.

rules.name: The Real Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset downward with a tight core and a long soft tail. No centered glows, no coloured shadows, no blur used as decoration.

rules.name: The No Gradient Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat fills. Legacy gradient utilities render as solid fills.

dos: Do build structure from courses: full-width bands of blocks with a 5px shadow-stone joint, varying spans row to row so joints never stack.
Do end a section with a chevron band (8px under the nav, 16px or 24px between courses) and tone it for its ground.
Do keep every corner square and every border a hairline, except the 6px ochre gateway top edge and the 3px active-nav underline.
Do give raised things a real offset shadow (the slab recipe) and keep everything else flat.
Do use logo blue or navy for every action and ochre only as a marker.
Do set headings in Archivo at 700 or 800 and text in Public Sans, and keep lines to max-w-prose.
Do give each audience its own gateway on the home page and keep touch targets at 44px or larger.
Do keep the school crest, MavingTech mark, Ministry, ZIMSEC and Cambridge logos and the real photography unaltered; photographs go through StoneWall or sit in a thick stone frame.
Do keep layouts tolerant of longer Shona and Ndebele strings.
donts: Don't put a kicker, eyebrow or small tracked-caps label above a heading.
Don't use a coloured side stripe on any block, callout or row. The ochre edge belongs only on the top of a gateway or slab and under the active nav item.
Don't use gradients on surfaces or text, gradient text, or glassy blur.
Don't use cards as the structure of a page; use masonry blocks, rows, rules and gateways instead.
Don't round corners, add pill shapes, or use soft glow shadows.
Don't fill a surface with ochre or set ochre body text on light ground.
Don't add a second accent colour, or revive maroon and gold.
Don't add a hero carousel, a quick-link icon bar, or a floating stat-card strip.
Don't add motion beyond course-lay; no scroll reveals, parallax or looping animation.
Don't invent figures. The home stats exist in code with undocumented sources and are not to be extended.
